review: Independent AI-agent review, not a human study. Same predeclared adequacy criteria as v1. A short acceptance of an explicit request can be adequate; bare repeated user emotions or wishes without an answer are partial. Quality remains separate from mere fluency and source novelty. This is a known Development replay after final freeze, not another unseen test. All20 token streams match v2; three rendered texts differ.
